originalSchedule.note: Supervisor deliberately stopped only after the final IO child finished and released its guard. Its last phase remains running in that interrupted scheduler receipt; the completed child result and guard above establish the pass. No HTTP phase launched in that schedule.

pause.action: Pause only the serial supervisor; let its existing final IO workload finish under the unchanged resource guard
pause.reason: Next HTTP builds copy 2.06 GiB of standard module data twice; current disk headroom is insufficient for their actual profile
pause.supervisorAction: Interrupt the paused supervisor after its completed child released the guard; preserve original schedule and continue with a new disk profile

limitations: All comparisons ran on Linux x64. The windows-timezone fixture exercises only its Linux fallback branch.
These inputs do not establish complete IO.FS, console, concurrency or other standard-library behavior.
Source-hidden relocated execution with empty PATH is not filesystem denial; the separate cold Node deployment has that stricter control.
HTTP testing continues separately after adjusting for its 2.06 GiB runtime-metadata copies.
